citation: Whelehan et al. 2024. The addition of mycoprotein to a mixed-meal impacts postprandial glucose kinetics without altering blood glucose concentrations: a randomised controlled trial. Eur J Clin Nutr 78:757.
protocol: 250 mL full-fat milk drink with 50 g dextrose (glucose) plus 20 g mycoprotein (MYC) or control (CON), ingested at t=0; glucose kinetics over 6 h with a primed [6,6-2H2]glucose infusion; 1000 mg [U-13C6]glucose added in 12 participants.
population: 24 adults, 8 F / 16 M, BMI 30 +/- 6 kg/m2 (range 22.2-38.5), age 30.1 (SD 8.4) y, fasting glucose 4.6 (SD 0.4) mmol/L; all but one had 2 h glucose below 6 mmol/L. Not described as healthy in the text.
note: Glucose AUC printed as mean (SEM) and total appearance as mean (SD) in the text, with n. EGP, RaEx and insulin are figure-only, so not taken. Population is adults across a BMI range with normal 2 h glucose, but the paper never calls them healthy; check before use.
